title: Travelling to Work
text:
Many people travel by train because it is fast and comfortable. However, trains can be late when the weather is bad. Therefore, passengers often check the timetable before they leave home. Although delays are common, most trains still arrive on time.

Some travellers prefer buses instead. Buses are usually cheaper, but they can be slower in heavy traffic. In addition, buses stop in more places, which is useful for people in small towns. Consequently, many students choose the bus when they want to save money.

questions.text: According to the passage, why do many people travel by train?
options: Because it is fast and comfortable
Because it goes to every small town

questions.text: According to the passage, why are buses useful for people in small towns?
options: They are always the fastest option

questions.text: What can be inferred about passengers who check the timetable before they leave home?
options: They want to avoid unnecessary waiting
They do not care about delays

questions.text: What is the main purpose of the second paragraph?
options: To explain why trains are dangerous
To describe how to buy tickets online
To list the history of public transport

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas viajam de trem porque ele é rápido e confortável. No entanto, os trens podem atrasar quando o tempo está ruim. Portanto, os passageiros costumam consultar o horário antes de sair de casa. Embora os atrasos sejam comuns, a maioria dos trens ainda chega na hora.

Alguns viajantes preferem ônibus. Os ônibus costumam ser mais baratos, mas podem ser mais lentos no trânsito intenso. Além disso, os ônibus param em mais lugares, o que é útil para pessoas de cidades pequenas. Por isso, muitos estudantes escolhem o ônibus quando querem economizar dinheiro.
